title: Sheehan as counsel to Disclosure Project, John Mack and Elizondo

tellings.quote: he knew perfectly well that for 20 years I was legal counsel for the disclosure project he knew I represented Dr John Mack he knew that I was at the peer group

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that for 20 years he was legal counsel to the Disclosure Project, a campaign to get the government to release what it knows about UFOs, and that he also represented Dr John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien encounters. Sheehan tells Michels this from his own career, and he says Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office studying unexplained aerial reports, knew all of this perfectly well, along with Sheehan's place in what he calls "the peer group"; he raises it to show he had long been in the middle of the effort to bring the subject into the open.
